brief: Selecting a primary view updates one stable selection group and semantic screen frame.
Selecting a project updates its selection group and screen frame.
Selecting a thread remains visually and semantically selected.
Switching roles selects an addressed channel rather than changing responder identity in place.
Only explicit group members receive group context.
Sibling direct-channel raw messages are not injected automatically.
Every message binds speaker and recipients.
New messages append without rebuilding the feed from the top.
Guide receives current screen, selection, breadcrumb and trajectory.
Required languages cover all visible keys or declare debt.
User layout changes positions without changing canonical relationships.
Collapsing a node hides children without deleting them.
Collapsed nodes report their direct child count.
Repeated equal health projections do not emit again.
Chat is keyboard navigable and labels expose stable identities.
Terrain has a non-drag keyboard/list alternative.
Health meaning does not rely on color alone.
Every source-managed identity is unique and every typed reference resolves.
Equal derived projections do not notify or rerender.
Visible tools and roles never infer effect authority.
Translation and Vex refinement preserve original attributed speech.
Score sharing never collapses distinct device companion lineages.
Bootstrap and repository contain no model weights; provisioning is external and checksummed.
Every registered platform receives identity, string, token, permission and conformance catalogs.
Blueprint changes produce bounded affected refs and never intentionally break stable platform mains.
Scrolling, zooming, panning, node dragging and overlay movement resolve without ambiguous gesture capture.
Every action vessel is keyboard reachable, dismissible and never obscures declared controls.
Companion, leadership, hybrid, newcomer and accessibility profiles receive bounded role-appropriate projections.
Home and platform back semantics preserve a stable route out without accidental exit.
Dream candidate and review never overwrite or delete exact source ranges.
Sibling synchronization preserves source lineage and remains a target-local candidate.
Training admission and accepted inactive checkpoints cannot activate themselves.
Implementation packet contains one work unit, direct dependencies, exact paths, sources, tests and exclusions.
Demo progress uses named gates and dependencies rather than an ungrounded percentage.
Atlas returns a bounded neighborhood plus coverage receipt.
Windows, macOS and Linux bootstrap plans are descriptive and non-writing in dry run.
Same-channel messages append from the bottom without rebuilding the feed.
Unregistered commands and out-of-scope working directories fail closed.
Actual serialized provider input stays below the admitted token ceiling.
Condensed context remains retraceable to immutable source ranges.
Direct and group channels isolate raw context by explicit membership.
Score synchronization respects record scope and does not import local Rhythm.
Adapter rollback restores a prior accepted device activation without deleting lineage evidence.
File edit requires expected hash and can restore the exact before-image.
Assigned roots do not escape through parent traversal or followed symlinks.
Issue cannot close without verification evidence and current projection update.
Model artifacts remain outside Git and require checksum/source receipt.
Every selectable element exposes one stable selected state in its group.
Android proves compile, UI, accessibility, lifecycle and permission contracts.
iOS proves compile, UI, accessibility, lifecycle and entitlement contracts.
macOS proves compile, UI, accessibility, sandbox and model-file access contracts.
Windows proves compile, UI, accessibility, process and filesystem contracts.
Public candidate contains no model binaries or partial artifacts.
Public candidate contains no runtime Score/history, credentials or private SDK files.
Compiled identity, strings, modules, processes, capabilities and work plans share canonical refs.
Dragging and collapse alter only user layout, never canonical relationships.
Workshop modifications and exports do not mutate live product source.
Capability frame uses the most restrictive role, platform, project, permission and resource stage.
Every registered feature carries the required cultural review lenses or an explicit held exemption.
Feature relationships resolve to canonical states, actions, permissions, modules, processes, tests and platforms.
Repository health runs only source-managed check identities and reports missing checks.
REMOTE_HOME, LOCAL_SIBLING and HYBRID never silently collapse companion lineages.
Pairing offers are expiring, single-use and reject replay.
Remote requests receive only the intersection of family, device, lease, role, project, permission and resource scopes.
Remote surfaces never become concurrent canonical writers to the desktop Vex Home.
Revocation generation invalidates future requests without deleting prior receipts.
Remote clients reach the Home Bridge gateway, never the raw model endpoint, filesystem or credential store.
